    About us

    A Sri Lankan band with a Milanese home and a European stage.

    Every chapter starts somewhere. Ours started in Milano.

    ChapterOne is a live band of musicians from Sri Lanka, based in Milano. We started with a simple idea: the songs we grew up with should sound as good in Europe as they do at home.

    Our name says where we are in the story. Moving to a new country is chapter one, and every show adds another page. Whether the room is a wedding hall, a community festival or a club, we play until the dance floor is full.

    Our audiences are big, loud and happy to sing along. That is the reason we do this.

    What you get when you book us

    The music

    Sri Lankan favourites, from baila to Sinhala hits, played by a full live band.

    The sound

    An indoor line array sound system, so the whole room hears the band clearly.

    The booking

    One clear package price, with transport added outside Milano. Eshan Perera handles every booking.
